title: Alt Coding-Agent Task Packet and Handoff Schema
description: Machine-verifiable schema for bounded coding-agent task packets and mandatory three-item handoff reports.

LintTarget.description: Target directory or named lint target accepted by ./scripts/lint/run.sh <target>.

AllowedPath.description: Repository-relative file path or glob pattern; parent traversal (..), unnormalized segments (//, /./), and absolute paths are forbidden.

RepoRelativeFilePath.description: Concrete repository-relative modified file path; parent traversal, unnormalized segments (//, /./, leading ./, trailing /), absolute paths, and glob wildcards are forbidden.

AllowedRule.description: Explicit lint rule, diagnostic ID, or scoped category. Wildcards (*) and ALL are forbidden.

Scope.description: Work-bounded scope constraints. Time-based fields (e.g., timeout_minutes) are forbidden via additionalProperties: false.

target.description: Single target or non-empty unique list of targets verified with ./scripts/lint/run.sh <target>.

allowed_paths.description: Non-empty list of repository-relative paths or globs the agent may edit.

forbidden_paths.description: Optional explicit exclusion globs that must never be edited.

allow_generated_code_edits.description: CHECK-05: explicit opt-in required to modify files carrying a generated-code DO NOT EDIT header.

allow_test_expectation_changes.description: LOOP-01: explicit opt-in required to modify test expectations or delete test files in lint-fix tasks.

max_files.description: Maximum number of files allowed to be modified (recommended default: 10, hard cap: 25).

max_functions.description: Maximum number of functions allowed to be modified (recommended default: 3, hard cap: 20).

allowed_rules.description: Non-empty explicit list of target rules or categories; wildcards and ALL are forbidden.

stop_condition.description: Explicit condition stating when the agent stops and produces a handoff.

MeasuredExecution.description: LOOP-02: host measurement record proving the verification command ran within budget before dispatch.

ExecutionPolicy.description: Deterministic execution and GUARD-01 safety constraints.

policy.description: CHECK-02 lint enforcement policy: fix-existing (resolve all existing findings) or block-new (ratchet/baseline existing findings and block new ones).

foreground_only.description: All commands must run synchronously in the foreground; background '&' is forbidden.

forbid_repo_wide_test_build.description: Prevent agents from invoking repo-wide builds or test suites handled by the host.

forbid_bulk_autofix.description: GUARD-01: forbid logic-mutating bulk autofix commands such as golangci-lint --fix, cargo clippy --fix, ruff check --unsafe-fixes, and biome check --write --unsafe.

max_command_budget_s.description: LOOP-02: maximum allowed wall-clock duration in seconds for the host verification command (1..600, default 180).

HandoffRequirements.description: Mandatory three-item handoff requirements enforced on completion.

TaskPacket.description: Canonical work-bounded assignment packet for a coding agent.

base_commit.description: Optional base commit SHA used by LOOP-01 verify-handoff and VERIFY-01 verify-sequence.

task_kind.description: Task classification controlling lint-fix strictness and verification mode.

behavior_preserving.description: Whether the task preserves observable runtime behavior (used by VERIFY-01 verify-sequence).

BehaviorCandidateResponse.description: CHECK-01 explicit disposition for an AST behavior-change screener candidate.

RuntimeBehaviorImpact.description: Explicit evaluation of potential runtime behavior changes.

summary.description: Non-empty confirmation of runtime impact; must explicitly state evidence or '変更なし' even when has_change is false.

candidate_responses.description: CHECK-01 per-candidate disposition responses answering behavior screener output.

TaskHandoff.description: Canonical three-item handoff report produced when bounded task work completes or stops.

rationale.description: Explicit rationale for changes, or explicit '変更なし' when unchanged. Placeholders such as TBD/N/A/- are rejected.
